description: Error chain: scaffold stub node_name='unknown' / registration flipping contract_passed. D1: scaffold_onex_node returns stub instead of raising on validation failure. D2: run_agent derives contract_passed from registration flag, not scaffold validation. OMN-12660.

D1.trigger: scaffold_onex_node receives a prompt that produces an invalid/incomplete node spec
D1.wrong_behavior: Returns stub with node_name='unknown', empty contract/handler fields
D1.correct_behavior: Raises a typed GenerationError with structured all_errors and correlation_id

D2.trigger: run_agent checks register_generated_tool returned registered=True after D1 stub
D2.correct_behavior: contract_passed is authoritative only from scaffold validation result, not registration

failure_mode: Delegation reports success with node_name='unknown', empty content, $0.00 cost — masking the real generation failure
regression_guard: node_name='unknown' in any terminal delegation event is a permanent hard failure. contract_passed=True with node_name='unknown' is a contradiction and must not occur.
authority_rule: registration status is NOT authoritative proof of contract validity; scaffold validation owns contract_passed truth
